summary.text: Delores McQuinn is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 81, which covers Charles City County and parts of Chesterfield and Henrico counties.
Delores McQuinn has been a member since January 14, 2009 and is the Minority Caucus Sergeant at Arms, a post listed as starting in 2012.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Delores McQuinn was born in Henrico, Virginia, in 1954.
Delores McQuinn studied at Virginia Commonwealth University and Virginia Union University.
Delores McQuinn's listed memberships and affiliations include New Bridge Baptist Church.
The profile lists Jonathan McQuinn as Delores McQuinn's spouse.

The House profile lists Delores McQuinn's committee assignments as Education, Appropriations, and Transportation, and Delores McQuinn chairs the Elementary and Secondary subcommittee of Appropriations.
